name: element.search
title: Search elements
summary: Full-text search over title, text, properties and IDs of the elements of a selection, typo tolerant, in any case, the best first.

query.description: Words split at spaces; every word must match (in the title, the text, a property value, the type or status name, or an ID). A word matches words it begins (from 2 letters) and with a typo (1 edit from 4 letters, 2 from 8; none for a query word with a digit), in any case. A short ID, an identifier or at least 6 hex digits of a UUID match that element exactly; ID matches come first. A query without a word finds nothing.

selection.description: Search only within it (SR-068 AK3): a view, a filter, a package or IDs.

fields.description: Search only these: `title`, `text` (the Markdown text), `properties` (every other value, type and status names; not relations), `id` (UUID, short ID, identifier). Default all.

output.description: One page of the hits, the best first: ID matches, then relevance, then workspace order. Waits for the search index while it is built.

repository.description: Workspace name of the repository of the element.

identifier.description: The value of the property with the meaning identifier, when the element has one.

status.description: The status key as written in the file.

score.description: Relevance of the matched words, rounded to 6 significant digits; 0 for an ID match only.

fields.description: What a word of the query was found in.

terms.description: The words of the element that matched, in lower case, for highlighting; none for an ID.
